svg.title: Mandorla
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection. Schematic of the directly inspected museum color image: central pale pointed lens, dark central seam, smaller lower teardrop and pale angular underpainting on the complete rectangular canvas. Low-contrast tonal layers, brushwork, worn edges and faint blue traces are simplified. Pale screen colors are intentionally retained; this is a major-motif navigation study, not a facsimile.
